title: As Fears of A.I. Catastrophe Magnify, Washington Stirs, but Mostly Slumbers
partialText: President Trump has been at the forefront of the “what-me-worry?” crowd, refusing to engage on how to balance the risks and rewards of A.I.

title: Top Lawmakers Agree A.I.’s Risks Are Rising but Say They Have No Quick Fix
partialText: House Speaker Mike Johnson warned on Sunday of competitive risks from China, and Hakeem Jeffries, the minority leader, said Congress should start regulatory talks this week.

title: What Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei Argued in His Call for AI Slowdown
partialText: Dario Amodei’s 3,800-word letter laid out a three-step plan to rein in artificial intelligence.

title: Obama Urges Democrats to Move A.I. Oversight to the Center of Their Agenda
partialText: During a private fund-raiser, the former president warned that the technology could be “dangerous” if not managed urgently and with a clear plan.

title: How Iran’s Hard-liners Blew Up the Peace Deal with Trump
partialText: Opponents derailed the agreement with a clandestine effort to attack ships in the Strait of Hormuz, regime insiders say. Iran’s president was furious when he found out.

title: Iran Will Meet With Gulf Arab States as Mideast Conflict Widens
partialText: Talks are expected tomorrow, officials said, as a ship was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz and Iranian allies in Yemen said they had launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia.

title: Inside the Impeachment Trial that Threatened to End Ken Paxton’s Political Career
partialText: Mr. Paxton, the Texas attorney general now running for the U.S. Senate, was accused of abusing the power of his office to protect a campaign donor. He was acquitted on all counts.

title: Angie Nixon, Candidate for Senate, Takes Florida by Storm
partialText: The Democratic nominee for Senate faces strong headwinds in a decidedly Republican-leaning state. She has been a fighter, and an underdog, for years.

title: How One Man’s Quest for a Musketeer’s Bones Got Him Locked Up
partialText: A secret archaeological dig inside a Dutch church has led to drama worthy of Alexandre Dumas. Did Wim Dijkman really find the bones of the fourth musketeer? We may never know.

title: Let the U.S. Open Fly Its Freak Flag
partialText: Many are complaining about influencers invading Flushing Meadows. But their biggest crime is distracting from the glorious chaos that typifies this tournament.

title: Ella Langley. ‘Landman.’ The Rural Vibe Shift Is Real.
partialText: Social marginalization means something different today.

title: The College Catwalk
partialText: We take a look at what’s cool on campus.

title: Did Trump Win the Battle Over the Smithsonian?
partialText: Lonnie G. Bunch III, who has led the institution since 2019, parried the White House until deciding it was time to go.
